initial_capture_limitation: 01-start-objects inherited original preferences before separate bundle identity; not first-launch evidence. It will not be used as evidence of defaults.
relaunch_note: After the Files crash, the UI tool relaunched the app without the isolated home. That graph state was rejected; the process was terminated before personal file operations. A launcher subsequently enforced the disposable home for all launches. User files were not intentionally mutated or exported. Incidental native picker directory labels were excluded from audit evidence.
launch_wrapper: Native launcher enforces CFFIXED_USER_HOME. Product binary retained as NauticaReal; ad hoc re-signing changes signature bytes. Source code is unmodified; this instrumented bundle is not the distribution build.
